data.name: Ody
data.short_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Odysseus', meaning 'hated by god'
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Odysseus was a king of Ithaca and a legendary hero, known for his cunning, resourcefulness, and strong will. He was hated by Poseidon, the god of the sea, but his determination and courage allowed him to overcome the god's wrath and return home to his wife Penelope after the Trojan War. Ody is a modern adaptation of this powerful and enduring name.
